PostgreSQL is a built-in core data source in Grafana, so you don't need to install a plugin. In this milestone, you add the PostgreSQL data source and give it a descriptive name.

Let's walk through the steps together.
Open **Connections > Data sources** to review your existing connections.
Open the data source catalog to choose a connection type.
To rename the data source, click the pencil icon next to its name, enter a descriptive name such as Production PostgreSQL, then click **Save**.
You opened the PostgreSQL data source settings and learned where to rename the connection. In the next milestone, configure its connection details.
